title: vacation.rs destroy loop: unwrap_or("") on non-string ID instead of skip
description: vacation.rs:235: 'let id = id_val.as_str().unwrap_or("")' — if destroy contains a non-string value, id = "". A SetError is then inserted for key "" (empty string). This is wrong and inconsistent with the pattern in email.rs:522-524 and submission.rs:300-303 which use 'match ... { Some(s) => s, None => continue }' to skip non-strings. Fix: match id_val.as_str() { Some(s) => s, None => continue }.
